ja: 「噂じゃ、縁寿ちゃん。あんた、ビルの天辺から飛び降りたんだって？」
en: “I hear you jumped off the top of a building, Ange. Is that true?”
rows.enText: “I hear you jumped off the top of a building, Ange. Is that true?”
rows.jaText: 「噂じゃ、縁寿ちゃん。あんた、ビルの天辺から飛び降りたんだって？」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「追っ掛けがウザかったんで、ちょっと撒こうと思って」
en: “The people following me were getting annoying. I thought I’d shake them off.”
rows.enText: “The people following me were getting annoying. I thought I’d shake them off.”
rows.jaText: 「追っ掛けがウザかったんで、ちょっと撒こうと思って」

ja: 広大で近代的な会議室に、縁寿と、上等なスーツを着た老紳士が二人きりでいた。プレゼンテーション用のあらゆる最新機材が準備され、それでいて上品で落ち着いた雰囲気を損なっていないその会議室は、ただそれだけで、この会議室の主である企業の格を知らしめ威圧している。
en: Ange sat alone with an elderly gentleman in an expensive suit, in a vast, modern conference room. It had all the latest presentation equipment without sacrificing its quiet elegance. The room alone proclaimed the stature of the company that owned it, and intimidated anyone who entered.
rows.enText: Ange sat alone with an elderly gentleman in an expensive suit, in a vast, modern conference room. It had all the latest presentation equipment without sacrificing its quiet elegance. The room alone proclaimed the stature of the company that owned it, and intimidated anyone who entered.
rows.jaText: 広大で近代的な会議室に、縁寿と、上等なスーツを着た老紳士が二人きりでいた。プレゼンテーション用のあらゆる最新機材が準備され、それでいて上品で落ち着いた雰囲気を損なっていないその会議室は、ただそれだけで、この会議室の主である企業の格を知らしめ威圧している。

ja: もっとも、縁寿にはどうでもいいことだ。何千万もの年収を取るだろう役員たちが座る高級椅子にぞんざいに座り、飄々とした様子だった。
en: Not that Ange cared. She sprawled casually in an expensive chair meant for executives who probably earned tens of millions of yen a year.
rows.enText: Not that Ange cared. She sprawled casually in an expensive chair meant for executives who probably earned tens of millions of yen a year.
rows.jaText: もっとも、縁寿にはどうでもいいことだ。何千万もの年収を取るだろう役員たちが座る高級椅子にぞんざいに座り、飄々とした様子だった。

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「下の方の階で、改装工事してて転落防止ネットがあるの、知ってましたし」
en: “I knew they were renovating some of the lower floors. There were safety nets.”
rows.enText: “I knew they were renovating some of the lower floors. There were safety nets.”
rows.jaText: 「下の方の階で、改装工事してて転落防止ネットがあるの、知ってましたし」

ja: 縁寿はあっけらかんとした様子でそう言い放つが、実際には奇跡中の“奇跡”だ。改装工事中の転落防止ネットを何層も突き抜け、アトリウムの宙を飾っていた色とりどりの横断幕に受け止められては滑り落とされ、…最後の横断幕１枚にふわりと受け止められて無傷で地上に降り立ち、すたすたとその場を後にしたなんて…、香港映画顔負けだ。
en: She said it as though it were nothing, but in fact it had been a miracle among “miracles.” She’d broken through layer after layer of construction safety netting, landed on the colorful banners hanging across the atrium, slipped from one to the next... and finally been caught gently by the last banner, reached the ground without a scratch, and walked away. It would put a Hong Kong movie to shame.
rows.enText: She said it as though it were nothing, but in fact it had been a miracle among “miracles.” She’d broken through layer after layer of construction safety netting, landed on the colorful banners hanging across the atrium, slipped from one to the next... and finally been caught gently by the last banner, reached the ground without a scratch, and walked away. It would put a Hong Kong movie to shame.
rows.jaText: 縁寿はあっけらかんとした様子でそう言い放つが、実際には奇跡中の“奇跡”だ。改装工事中の転落防止ネットを何層も突き抜け、アトリウムの宙を飾っていた色とりどりの横断幕に受け止められては滑り落とされ、…最後の横断幕１枚にふわりと受け止められて無傷で地上に降り立ち、すたすたとその場を後にしたなんて…、香港映画顔負けだ。

ja: 「いくらネットがあるの知ってた、たってぇ、高さ２００ｍの超高層だよ？　もしも思い通りにならなかったら、今頃、大変なことになってただろうよ」
en: “Nets or no nets, that skyscraper’s two hundred meters high! If things hadn’t gone your way, you’d be in a very bad state right now.”
rows.enText: “Nets or no nets, that skyscraper’s two hundred meters high! If things hadn’t gone your way, you’d be in a very bad state right now.”
rows.jaText: 「いくらネットがあるの知ってた、たってぇ、高さ２００ｍの超高層だよ？　もしも思い通りにならなかったら、今頃、大変なことになってただろうよ」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「……死んだら死んだで、それまでってことでもいいかなって思いまして。まぁその、ちょっとした運試しです。若気の至りってことで」
en: “If I died, I thought that could just be the end of it. I was testing my luck a little. Put it down to youthful folly.”
rows.enText: “If I died, I thought that could just be the end of it. I was testing my luck a little. Put it down to youthful folly.”
rows.jaText: 「……死んだら死んだで、それまでってことでもいいかなって思いまして。まぁその、ちょっとした運試しです。若気の至りってことで」

ja: 縁寿は、その話はもういいとでも言うように、素っ気無く肩をすくめる。その様子に、眼下の下界を見下ろす老紳士はからからと笑った。
en: Ange gave a curt shrug, as though that was enough of that subject. Looking down at the world beneath them, the old gentleman laughed heartily.
rows.enText: Ange gave a curt shrug, as though that was enough of that subject. Looking down at the world beneath them, the old gentleman laughed heartily.
rows.jaText: 縁寿は、その話はもういいとでも言うように、素っ気無く肩をすくめる。その様子に、眼下の下界を見下ろす老紳士はからからと笑った。

ja: 「運試しと来たか…！　いやはや、やっぱり金蔵さんのお孫さんだねぇ。運否天賦。天の流れに命を預けてもけろりとしてる、その度胸。…会長も博打に平気で命を賭けられる人だったが、これも右代宮の血なのかねぇ」
en: “Testing your luck! Well, well. You really are Kinzou’s granddaughter. Leave it all to chance. Entrust your life to the heavens without batting an eye. That nerve... The chair could stake her life on a gamble too. Is it in the Ushiromiya blood?”
rows.enText: “Testing your luck! Well, well. You really are Kinzou’s granddaughter. Leave it all to chance. Entrust your life to the heavens without batting an eye. That nerve... The chair could stake her life on a gamble too. Is it in the Ushiromiya blood?”
rows.jaText: 「運試しと来たか…！　いやはや、やっぱり金蔵さんのお孫さんだねぇ。運否天賦。天の流れに命を預けてもけろりとしてる、その度胸。…会長も博打に平気で命を賭けられる人だったが、これも右代宮の血なのかねぇ」

ja: 「……やっぱりあんた、将来大物になるよ。悪いことは言わない。家出ごっこはこの辺で切り上げて、須磨寺の家に戻ったらどうだい」
en: “You’re going to be someone someday. Take my advice. Give up this little game of running away, and go back to the Sumadera family.”
rows.enText: “You’re going to be someone someday. Take my advice. Give up this little game of running away, and go back to the Sumadera family.”
rows.jaText: 「……やっぱりあんた、将来大物になるよ。悪いことは言わない。家出ごっこはこの辺で切り上げて、須磨寺の家に戻ったらどうだい」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「お母さん、実家と仲が悪かったって聞いてます。お葬式で初対面の人の家になんて、行きたくないです」
en: “I heard Mom didn’t get along with her family. I don’t want to live with people I first met at her funeral.”
rows.enText: “I heard Mom didn’t get along with her family. I don’t want to live with people I first met at her funeral.”
rows.jaText: 「お母さん、実家と仲が悪かったって聞いてます。お葬式で初対面の人の家になんて、行きたくないです」

ja: 須磨寺家は母の実家だ。京都のちょっとした旧家で、お母さんのフランクな様子からは想像もつかないくらいに厳格な一族だ。私が唯一、須磨寺家で仲が良かったのは、隠居という名の別居をしているお祖父ちゃんだけだった。母も、お祖父ちゃんとだけは交流を持っていたが、他の親族には険悪なまでに一切、関わり合わなかった。
en: The Sumaderas were my mother’s family. An old family of some standing in Kyoto, so rigid you’d never imagine my easygoing mother had come from them. The only one I’d ever been close to was my grandfather, who lived apart from them, supposedly in retirement. Mom had kept in touch with him too, but she’d had absolutely nothing to do with the others. Their relations were that bad.
rows.enText: The Sumaderas were my mother’s family. An old family of some standing in Kyoto, so rigid you’d never imagine my easygoing mother had come from them. The only one I’d ever been close to was my grandfather, who lived apart from them, supposedly in retirement. Mom had kept in touch with him too, but she’d had absolutely nothing to do with the others. Their relations were that bad.
rows.jaText: 須磨寺家は母の実家だ。京都のちょっとした旧家で、お母さんのフランクな様子からは想像もつかないくらいに厳格な一族だ。私が唯一、須磨寺家で仲が良かったのは、隠居という名の別居をしているお祖父ちゃんだけだった。母も、お祖父ちゃんとだけは交流を持っていたが、他の親族には険悪なまでに一切、関わり合わなかった。

ja: 私も、須磨寺家で遊びに行ったのはお祖父ちゃんの家だけだ。幼い私は、当時はよくわからなかったが、お祖父ちゃんは入り婿で立場も非常に弱く、お祖母ちゃんとの仲も悪かったという。…むしろ、お祖母ちゃんに嫌われ、蟄居させられていたとすら、言い切れたかもしれない。
en: His was the only Sumadera home I’d ever visited. I hadn’t understood much of it when I was little, but he’d married into the family and had very little standing. Apparently he and my grandmother hadn’t gotten along either. Perhaps it would be more accurate to say she’d hated him and banished him to seclusion.
rows.enText: His was the only Sumadera home I’d ever visited. I hadn’t understood much of it when I was little, but he’d married into the family and had very little standing. Apparently he and my grandmother hadn’t gotten along either. Perhaps it would be more accurate to say she’d hated him and banished him to seclusion.
rows.jaText: 私も、須磨寺家で遊びに行ったのはお祖父ちゃんの家だけだ。幼い私は、当時はよくわからなかったが、お祖父ちゃんは入り婿で立場も非常に弱く、お祖母ちゃんとの仲も悪かったという。…むしろ、お祖母ちゃんに嫌われ、蟄居させられていたとすら、言い切れたかもしれない。

ja: そんなお祖父ちゃんにだけ心を許していたということは、恐らく、母も、須磨寺家には嫌われていただろうことは、想像に難くない。その娘である私も、さぞや嫌われていたことだろう。
en: If he was the only one Mom had trusted, it wasn’t hard to imagine that the Sumaderas had hated her too. They must have hated me, her daughter, just as much.
rows.enText: If he was the only one Mom had trusted, it wasn’t hard to imagine that the Sumaderas had hated her too. They must have hated me, her daughter, just as much.
rows.jaText: そんなお祖父ちゃんにだけ心を許していたということは、恐らく、母も、須磨寺家には嫌われていただろうことは、想像に難くない。その娘である私も、さぞや嫌われていたことだろう。

ja: にもかかわらず、お母さんたちのお葬式の時に初めて現れて、大きくなったわね、何てしゃあしゃあとのたまって、よくも今さら親族面が出来るものだ…。
en: Yet they’d shown up for the first time at my family’s funeral, coolly told me how much I’d grown, and had the nerve to act like relatives after all that...
rows.enText: Yet they’d shown up for the first time at my family’s funeral, coolly told me how much I’d grown, and had the nerve to act like relatives after all that...
rows.jaText: にもかかわらず、お母さんたちのお葬式の時に初めて現れて、大きくなったわね、何てしゃあしゃあとのたまって、よくも今さら親族面が出来るものだ…。

ja: 絵羽伯母さんが死んだ後、右代宮家の全ての財産は私が相続している。それが目当てでなかったら、あんな虫唾が走るような言葉を口になんか出来るものか。
en: After Aunt Eva died, I’d inherited the entire Ushiromiya fortune. If that wasn’t what they wanted, how could they have said such sickening things?
rows.enText: After Aunt Eva died, I’d inherited the entire Ushiromiya fortune. If that wasn’t what they wanted, how could they have said such sickening things?
rows.jaText: 絵羽伯母さんが死んだ後、右代宮家の全ての財産は私が相続している。それが目当てでなかったら、あんな虫唾が走るような言葉を口になんか出来るものか。

ja: 「……まぁ、ひとりぼっちになっちまって、自暴自棄になりたい縁寿ちゃんの気持ちも、わからなくもないなぁ」
en: “Well... I can understand wanting to throw it all away when you’ve been left alone, Ange.”
rows.enText: “Well... I can understand wanting to throw it all away when you’ve been left alone, Ange.”
rows.jaText: 「……まぁ、ひとりぼっちになっちまって、自暴自棄になりたい縁寿ちゃんの気持ちも、わからなくもないなぁ」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「自暴自棄とかじゃないです。小うるさい絵羽伯母さんもやっとくたばったんで、久し振りに伸び伸びと散歩してるだけじゃないですか。……周りが大袈裟に騒ぎ過ぎなだけです」
en: “I’m not throwing anything away. Aunt Eva finally dropped dead, so I’m enjoying a walk without anyone nagging me for once. Everyone else is making far too much of it.”
rows.enText: “I’m not throwing anything away. Aunt Eva finally dropped dead, so I’m enjoying a walk without anyone nagging me for once. Everyone else is making far too much of it.”
rows.jaText: 「自暴自棄とかじゃないです。小うるさい絵羽伯母さんもやっとくたばったんで、久し振りに伸び伸びと散歩してるだけじゃないですか。……周りが大袈裟に騒ぎ過ぎなだけです」

ja: どうせみんなの目当ては、私が背負ってる莫大な右代宮家の財産なのだ。私の後見人になれば、財産を自由に出来ると思ってるに違いない。私の親代わりになろうと言って近付いてくる連中がどれだけ大勢いることか。
en: They were all after the enormous Ushiromiya fortune on my back anyway. They must have thought becoming my guardian would let them do what they liked with it. So many people had come to me offering to take my parents’ place.
rows.enText: They were all after the enormous Ushiromiya fortune on my back anyway. They must have thought becoming my guardian would let them do what they liked with it. So many people had come to me offering to take my parents’ place.
rows.jaText: どうせみんなの目当ては、私が背負ってる莫大な右代宮家の財産なのだ。私の後見人になれば、財産を自由に出来ると思ってるに違いない。私の親代わりになろうと言って近付いてくる連中がどれだけ大勢いることか。

ja: 「縁寿ちゃんも、辛いことがあったら、俺で良かったらいつでも相談してな？　縁寿ちゃんのこと、実の孫みたいに思ってるんだからさ」
en: “If anything’s troubling you, you can always talk to me, Ange. If you don’t mind an old man like me. I think of you as my own granddaughter.”
rows.enText: “If anything’s troubling you, you can always talk to me, Ange. If you don’t mind an old man like me. I think of you as my own granddaughter.”
rows.jaText: 「縁寿ちゃんも、辛いことがあったら、俺で良かったらいつでも相談してな？　縁寿ちゃんのこと、実の孫みたいに思ってるんだからさ」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「………………………はぁ。…当面はノーサンキューということで。…それより、話を戻して下さい」
en: “...Right. No thanks, for now. Can we get back to what we were talking about?”
rows.enText: “...Right. No thanks, for now. Can we get back to what we were talking about?”
rows.jaText: 「………………………はぁ。…当面はノーサンキューということで。…それより、話を戻して下さい」

ja: 「縁寿ちゃん。何度聞かれたって、俺が隠してることは何もないよ。あの日の六軒島の唯一の生き残りが会長なんだ。その会長が、何も語らずに逝っちまった」
en: “Ange. No matter how often you ask, I’m not hiding anything. The chair was the only person who survived that day on Rokkenjima. And she went to her grave without saying a word.”
rows.enText: “Ange. No matter how often you ask, I’m not hiding anything. The chair was the only person who survived that day on Rokkenjima. And she went to her grave without saying a word.”
rows.jaText: 「縁寿ちゃん。何度聞かれたって、俺が隠してることは何もないよ。あの日の六軒島の唯一の生き残りが会長なんだ。その会長が、何も語らずに逝っちまった」

ja: 「俺だって何もわからないよ。全ては闇の中、だ」
en: “I don’t know anything either. It’s all in the dark.”
rows.enText: “I don’t know anything either. It’s all in the dark.”
rows.jaText: 「俺だって何もわからないよ。全ては闇の中、だ」

ja: 老紳士は、絵羽亡き後、彼女が築き上げた企業グループを任された重鎮の一人だった。彼が会長と呼ぶのは、前会長、右代宮絵羽のことだ。彼の会社はかつて、秀吉の会社と友好的な関係にあり、秀吉や絵羽とも親密な交流があった。
en: The old gentleman was one of the senior figures entrusted, after Eva’s death, with the group of companies she’d built. The chair he spoke of was its former chair, Eva Ushiromiya. His company had once had friendly relations with Hideyoshi’s, and he’d been close to both Hideyoshi and Eva.
rows.enText: The old gentleman was one of the senior figures entrusted, after Eva’s death, with the group of companies she’d built. The chair he spoke of was its former chair, Eva Ushiromiya. His company had once had friendly relations with Hideyoshi’s, and he’d been close to both Hideyoshi and Eva.
rows.jaText: 老紳士は、絵羽亡き後、彼女が築き上げた企業グループを任された重鎮の一人だった。彼が会長と呼ぶのは、前会長、右代宮絵羽のことだ。彼の会社はかつて、秀吉の会社と友好的な関係にあり、秀吉や絵羽とも親密な交流があった。

ja: その為、秀吉を失った後の絵羽が、唯一本音を漏らせる人物だったともされる。家族を失った絵羽が心を病み、縁寿に辛く当たるようになると、彼はその間の緩衝材的な役割も担ってくれたため、心が許せるほどではないが、縁寿にとっても訪ねやすい人物だった…。
en: After Hideyoshi’s death, he was said to have been the only person Eva could speak to freely. Losing her family had unbalanced Eva. When she began treating Ange harshly, he’d also acted as a buffer between them. Ange didn’t quite trust him, but he was someone she could visit...
rows.enText: After Hideyoshi’s death, he was said to have been the only person Eva could speak to freely. Losing her family had unbalanced Eva. When she began treating Ange harshly, he’d also acted as a buffer between them. Ange didn’t quite trust him, but he was someone she could visit...
rows.jaText: その為、秀吉を失った後の絵羽が、唯一本音を漏らせる人物だったともされる。家族を失った絵羽が心を病み、縁寿に辛く当たるようになると、彼はその間の緩衝材的な役割も担ってくれたため、心が許せるほどではないが、縁寿にとっても訪ねやすい人物だった…。

ja: 「あの事件は、…いや、事故か。事件なんて言っちまったら怒られちまうなぁ。…そりゃ俺も世間やワイドショーと同じ程度の疑問は持ったさ」
en: “That crime... No, accident. I’ll get in trouble if I call it a crime. Of course I had the same questions as everyone else, and the talk shows.”
rows.enText: “That crime... No, accident. I’ll get in trouble if I call it a crime. Of course I had the same questions as everyone else, and the talk shows.”
rows.jaText: 「あの事件は、…いや、事故か。事件なんて言っちまったら怒られちまうなぁ。…そりゃ俺も世間やワイドショーと同じ程度の疑問は持ったさ」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「……どうして絵羽伯母さんは事故当時、屋敷から２ｋｍも離れたところに、たったひとりで？　それも嵐の晩に」
en: “Why was Aunt Eva alone, two kilometers from the mansion, when it happened? On a stormy night, too.”
rows.enText: “Why was Aunt Eva alone, two kilometers from the mansion, when it happened? On a stormy night, too.”
rows.jaText: 「……どうして絵羽伯母さんは事故当時、屋敷から２ｋｍも離れたところに、たったひとりで？　それも嵐の晩に」

ja: 「当時、金蔵さんは次の跡継ぎに誰を選ぶかで迷われていた。……表向きは長男の蔵臼さんってことになってたんだが、蔵臼さんはあまり信頼されていなかったんだ」
en: “Kinzou was having trouble choosing his successor then. Officially, it was his eldest son, Krauss. But he didn’t have much confidence in Krauss.”
rows.enText: “Kinzou was having trouble choosing his successor then. Officially, it was his eldest son, Krauss. But he didn’t have much confidence in Krauss.”
rows.jaText: 「当時、金蔵さんは次の跡継ぎに誰を選ぶかで迷われていた。……表向きは長男の蔵臼さんってことになってたんだが、蔵臼さんはあまり信頼されていなかったんだ」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「……それで、親兄弟４人の中から公平に跡継ぎを決めるため、碑文の謎というゲーム染みた試練を課した…？」
en: “So he set them that trial, the riddle of the epitaph, almost like a game... to choose fairly among his four children?”
rows.enText: “So he set them that trial, the riddle of the epitaph, almost like a game... to choose fairly among his four children?”
rows.jaText: 「……それで、親兄弟４人の中から公平に跡継ぎを決めるため、碑文の謎というゲーム染みた試練を課した…？」

ja: 「それは表向きだなぁ。……恐らく金蔵さんは、初めから絵羽さんを当主跡継ぎにするつもりだったんだ」「長男が跡継ぎだという自らのルールを撤回してでも、蔵臼さんと違い、非常に勤勉で優秀だった絵羽さんに家を任せたかったんだ」
en: “That was the official story. I suspect he’d intended to make Eva his successor from the beginning. He wanted to entrust the family to her. She was very hardworking and capable, unlike Krauss, and he was willing to revoke his own rule that the eldest son inherited.”
rows.enText: “That was the official story. I suspect he’d intended to make Eva his successor from the beginning. He wanted to entrust the family to her. She was very hardworking and capable, unlike Krauss, and he was willing to revoke his own rule that the eldest son inherited.”
rows.jaText: 「それは表向きだなぁ。……恐らく金蔵さんは、初めから絵羽さんを当主跡継ぎにするつもりだったんだ」「長男が跡継ぎだという自らのルールを撤回してでも、蔵臼さんと違い、非常に勤勉で優秀だった絵羽さんに家を任せたかったんだ」

ja: 「…碑文の謎を解いた者に家督を引き継ぐなどという新ルールは、蔵臼さんから次期当主の肩書きを奪うためだけの茶番だったんだろうな」
en: “The new rule, that whoever solved the epitaph would inherit the headship, was probably just a charade to strip Krauss of his title as the next head.”
rows.enText: “The new rule, that whoever solved the epitaph would inherit the headship, was probably just a charade to strip Krauss of his title as the next head.”
rows.jaText: 「…碑文の謎を解いた者に家督を引き継ぐなどという新ルールは、蔵臼さんから次期当主の肩書きを奪うためだけの茶番だったんだろうな」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「茶番って、どういう意味ですか？」
en: “What do you mean, a charade?”
rows.enText: “What do you mean, a charade?”
rows.jaText: 「茶番って、どういう意味ですか？」

ja: 「あの碑文は誰にも解ける必要はなかったのさ。適当に掲示期間を経た後、本当に金蔵さんが跡を継がせたかった絵羽さんを呼び出し、
その答えを与える
i
だけでいい。つまり、それこそが当主継承の証ってわけさ」
en: “No one needed to solve that epitaph. He could leave it up for a suitable length of time, then summon Eva, the person he really wanted to succeed him, and
give her the answer
i
. That would be the proof of her succession.”
rows.enText: “No one needed to solve that epitaph. He could leave it up for a suitable length of time, then summon Eva, the person he really wanted to succeed him, and give her the answer. That would be the proof of her succession.”
rows.jaText: 「あの碑文は誰にも解ける必要はなかったのさ。適当に掲示期間を経た後、本当に金蔵さんが跡を継がせたかった絵羽さんを呼び出し、その答えを与えるだけでいい。つまり、それこそが当主継承の証ってわけさ」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「………………それはワイドショーでは言われていない話ですね？」
en: “That’s a story I haven’t heard on the talk shows.”
rows.enText: “That’s a story I haven’t heard on the talk shows.”
rows.jaText: 「………………それはワイドショーでは言われていない話ですね？」

ja: 「まぁ、当主継承が云々なんて話をしたら、余計、陰謀説が優勢になっちゃうからねぇ。俺も馬鹿じゃないからさ。誤解を招くようなことはわざわざ口にしないよ？」
en: “Well, bring the succession into it, and the conspiracy theories would only get stronger. I’m no fool. I don’t go out of my way to say things people might misunderstand.”
rows.enText: “Well, bring the succession into it, and the conspiracy theories would only get stronger. I’m no fool. I don’t go out of my way to say things people might misunderstand.”
rows.jaText: 「まぁ、当主継承が云々なんて話をしたら、余計、陰謀説が優勢になっちゃうからねぇ。俺も馬鹿じゃないからさ。誤解を招くようなことはわざわざ口にしないよ？」

ja: 彼の話はこうだった。当時の右代宮家では、余命わずかと宣告された当主の金蔵が、跡継ぎ問題に頭を悩ませていた。本来なら跡継ぎは、自らが定めた長男の蔵臼に決まる。…しかし、晩年の金蔵は、絵羽の方が当主に相応しいと思い始めていたというのだ。
en: This was his account. At the time, Kinzou, head of the Ushiromiya family, had been told he had little time left to live, and was worrying about the succession. Ordinarily it would pass to his eldest son, Krauss, under the rule he’d laid down himself. But in his later years, he’d begun to think Eva was better suited to the headship.
rows.enText: This was his account. At the time, Kinzou, head of the Ushiromiya family, had been told he had little time left to live, and was worrying about the succession. Ordinarily it would pass to his eldest son, Krauss, under the rule he’d laid down himself. But in his later years, he’d begun to think Eva was better suited to the headship.
rows.jaText: 彼の話はこうだった。当時の右代宮家では、余命わずかと宣告された当主の金蔵が、跡継ぎ問題に頭を悩ませていた。本来なら跡継ぎは、自らが定めた長男の蔵臼に決まる。…しかし、晩年の金蔵は、絵羽の方が当主に相応しいと思い始めていたというのだ。

ja: しかし自らにも頑固な金蔵は、自ら蔵臼に与えた次期当主という肩書きが邪魔で、蔵臼を飛び越えて絵羽を次期当主に選ぶことの出来る
建前
i
を探していた。その建前が、碑文の謎。
en: Kinzou was stubborn even with himself. The title of next head, which he’d bestowed on Krauss himself, stood in his way. He was looking for a
pretext
i
that would let him pass Krauss over and choose Eva. The riddle of the epitaph was that pretext.
rows.enText: Kinzou was stubborn even with himself. The title of next head, which he’d bestowed on Krauss himself, stood in his way. He was looking for a pretext that would let him pass Krauss over and choose Eva. The riddle of the epitaph was that pretext.
rows.jaText: しかし自らにも頑固な金蔵は、自ら蔵臼に与えた次期当主という肩書きが邪魔で、蔵臼を飛び越えて絵羽を次期当主に選ぶことの出来る建前を探していた。その建前が、碑文の謎。

ja: 本来の当主跡継ぎは蔵臼だが、もしもその謎を解く者が現れたなら、そちらを当主跡継ぎに選ぶという新たなルール。そして金蔵は、恐らく自分にとって最後になるであろう親族会議の日に、その謎を自ら絵羽に伝えた。……それはつまり、絵羽こそが次期当主であるという宣言にも等しいわけだ。
en: Krauss was the rightful successor, but the new rule would let anyone who solved the riddle take his place. And on the day of what would probably be his last family conference, Kinzou had told Eva the answer himself... In other words, he’d all but declared her the next head.
rows.enText: Krauss was the rightful successor, but the new rule would let anyone who solved the riddle take his place. And on the day of what would probably be his last family conference, Kinzou had told Eva the answer himself... In other words, he’d all but declared her the next head.
rows.jaText: 本来の当主跡継ぎは蔵臼だが、もしもその謎を解く者が現れたなら、そちらを当主跡継ぎに選ぶという新たなルール。そして金蔵は、恐らく自分にとって最後になるであろう親族会議の日に、その謎を自ら絵羽に伝えた。……それはつまり、絵羽こそが次期当主であるという宣言にも等しいわけだ。

ja: 「絵羽さんは、あの日、金蔵さんに呼ばれ、それを打ち明けられたんだ。そして、当主を引き継ぐため、当主だけが知る隠し館である九羽鳥庵に絵羽さんを呼びつけたのだ」
en: “Kinzou called Eva to him that day and told her. Then, to pass on the headship, he summoned her to Kuwadorian, the hidden mansion only the head knew about.”
rows.enText: “Kinzou called Eva to him that day and told her. Then, to pass on the headship, he summoned her to Kuwadorian, the hidden mansion only the head knew about.”
rows.jaText: 「絵羽さんは、あの日、金蔵さんに呼ばれ、それを打ち明けられたんだ。そして、当主を引き継ぐため、当主だけが知る隠し館である九羽鳥庵に絵羽さんを呼びつけたのだ」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「………で、一足早くその隠し館で待っていた絵羽伯母さんは、そのお陰で事故の難を逃れた、と？　絵羽伯母さんが、全ての財産を奪うために、事故を装ってみんなを殺し、自分だけ難を逃れただけかもしれない」
en: “And because Aunt Eva went ahead to wait at that hidden mansion, she escaped the accident? Or perhaps she killed everyone to take the whole fortune, made it look like an accident, and saved herself.”
rows.enText: “And because Aunt Eva went ahead to wait at that hidden mansion, she escaped the accident? Or perhaps she killed everyone to take the whole fortune, made it look like an accident, and saved herself.”
rows.jaText: 「………で、一足早くその隠し館で待っていた絵羽伯母さんは、そのお陰で事故の難を逃れた、と？　絵羽伯母さんが、全ての財産を奪うために、事故を装ってみんなを殺し、自分だけ難を逃れただけかもしれない」

ja: 「大衆紙はそう騒いでるなぁ。だが、俺は絵羽さんを信じてるよ。……信ずるに足るポイントが、いくつかあると思ってる」
en: “That’s what the tabloids say. But I believe Eva. There are a few things that give me reason to.”
rows.enText: “That’s what the tabloids say. But I believe Eva. There are a few things that give me reason to.”
rows.jaText: 「大衆紙はそう騒いでるなぁ。だが、俺は絵羽さんを信じてるよ。……信ずるに足るポイントが、いくつかあると思ってる」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「例えば…？」
en: “Such as?”
rows.enText: “Such as?”
rows.jaText: 「例えば…？」

ja: 「今、縁寿ちゃんが指に通してるその、右代宮家当主の指輪だよ。その指輪は金蔵さんが特別に作らせた世界に１つしかない指輪だ。そして、今、縁寿ちゃんが指にしているものは、間違いなくそれだと、作った細工師も認めてる」
en: “The ring you’re wearing right now. The ring of the head of the Ushiromiya family. Kinzou had it specially made. There’s only one in the world. And the craftsman who made it has confirmed that the one you’re wearing is unquestionably that ring.”
rows.enText: “The ring you’re wearing right now. The ring of the head of the Ushiromiya family. Kinzou had it specially made. There’s only one in the world. And the craftsman who made it has confirmed that the one you’re wearing is unquestionably that ring.”
rows.jaText: 「今、縁寿ちゃんが指に通してるその、右代宮家当主の指輪だよ。その指輪は金蔵さんが特別に作らせた世界に１つしかない指輪だ。そして、今、縁寿ちゃんが指にしているものは、間違いなくそれだと、作った細工師も認めてる」

ja: 右代宮家、当主の指輪。黄金の重みがあり、片翼の紋章の入ったその指輪には、台座の部分にダイヤがあしらわれ、重厚感と金持ち的な悪趣味さを兼ね備えている。それは、金蔵が一時も外すことなく指にはめていたものだ。
en: The Ushiromiya head’s ring. Heavy with gold, it bore the one-winged crest and had diamonds set into its mounting. It combined a sense of solidity with the bad taste of the wealthy. Kinzou had worn it without ever taking it off.
rows.enText: The Ushiromiya head’s ring. Heavy with gold, it bore the one-winged crest and had diamonds set into its mounting. It combined a sense of solidity with the bad taste of the wealthy. Kinzou had worn it without ever taking it off.
rows.jaText: 右代宮家、当主の指輪。黄金の重みがあり、片翼の紋章の入ったその指輪には、台座の部分にダイヤがあしらわれ、重厚感と金持ち的な悪趣味さを兼ね備えている。それは、金蔵が一時も外すことなく指にはめていたものだ。

ja: それを絵羽が持つということは、金蔵が当主跡継ぎと認めた証に他ならない、というのだ。
en: Eva’s possession of it, he said, could only mean Kinzou had recognized her as his successor.
rows.enText: Eva’s possession of it, he said, could only mean Kinzou had recognized her as his successor.
rows.jaText: それを絵羽が持つということは、金蔵が当主跡継ぎと認めた証に他ならない、というのだ。

ja: 「その指輪を確かに絵羽さんが持つからこそ。そして、実際に絵羽さんが優秀で、蔵臼さんにはビジネスシーンでの数々の醜態が知られていたことを加味すると、絵羽さんの話はまったくの作り話とは思えないんだ」
en: “Eva certainly had that ring. And when you consider that she really was capable, while Krauss was known for one business humiliation after another... I can’t think her story was pure invention.”
rows.enText: “Eva certainly had that ring. And when you consider that she really was capable, while Krauss was known for one business humiliation after another... I can’t think her story was pure invention.”
rows.jaText: 「その指輪を確かに絵羽さんが持つからこそ。そして、実際に絵羽さんが優秀で、蔵臼さんにはビジネスシーンでの数々の醜態が知られていたことを加味すると、絵羽さんの話はまったくの作り話とは思えないんだ」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「…………その指輪を奪うために、お祖父さまを殺害した可能性だってあるけれど。そして絵羽伯母さんは、何らかの細工をして、事故に見せ掛けて一族を皆殺しにした」
en: “She could have murdered Grandfather to get it. Then she did something to make the whole family’s murder look like an accident.”
rows.enText: “She could have murdered Grandfather to get it. Then she did something to make the whole family’s murder look like an accident.”
rows.jaText: 「…………その指輪を奪うために、お祖父さまを殺害した可能性だってあるけれど。そして絵羽伯母さんは、何らかの細工をして、事故に見せ掛けて一族を皆殺しにした」

ja: 「そうだなぁ。大衆紙は財産の独り占めが目当てで一族を皆殺しにした、なんて言ってるようだなぁ」
en: “Yes. The tabloids seem to say she killed them all to keep the fortune for herself.”
rows.enText: “Yes. The tabloids seem to say she killed them all to keep the fortune for herself.”
rows.jaText: 「そうだなぁ。大衆紙は財産の独り占めが目当てで一族を皆殺しにした、なんて言ってるようだなぁ」

ja: 「確かに、絵羽さんはここ一番ではずいぶん思い切ったこともしちゃう人だよ。あるいは、……右代宮家の財産を独り占めできるチャンスに、生涯でただ一度の殺人を犯したかもしれない。…………だがね、俺はそうは思わない」
en: “She could certainly be very bold when it counted. Perhaps, faced with a chance to take the entire Ushiromiya fortune, she committed murder for the only time in her life. But I don’t think so.”
rows.enText: “She could certainly be very bold when it counted. Perhaps, faced with a chance to take the entire Ushiromiya fortune, she committed murder for the only time in her life. But I don’t think so.”
rows.jaText: 「確かに、絵羽さんはここ一番ではずいぶん思い切ったこともしちゃう人だよ。あるいは、……右代宮家の財産を独り占めできるチャンスに、生涯でただ一度の殺人を犯したかもしれない。…………だがね、俺はそうは思わない」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「そう信ずるに足るポイントの２つ目は？」
en: “What’s your second reason for believing that?”
rows.enText: “What’s your second reason for believing that?”
rows.jaText: 「そう信ずるに足るポイントの２つ目は？」

ja: 「絵羽さんのご家族だよ。秀吉さんに譲治くん。……縁寿ちゃんはにわかには信じ難いだろうけど、絵羽さんはあれでかなり家族を大事にする人だったんだ」
en: “Her family. Hideyoshi and George. You may find it hard to believe, Ange, but for all her faults, Eva cared a great deal about her family.”
rows.enText: “Her family. Hideyoshi and George. You may find it hard to believe, Ange, but for all her faults, Eva cared a great deal about her family.”
rows.jaText: 「絵羽さんのご家族だよ。秀吉さんに譲治くん。……縁寿ちゃんはにわかには信じ難いだろうけど、絵羽さんはあれでかなり家族を大事にする人だったんだ」

ja:
……確かににわかには信じたくないし、認めたくはない。
でも、薄々はわかっている。確かに絵羽伯母さんは、家族をとても大切にしている人だった。
en: It was hard to believe. I didn’t want to admit it. Yet I did know, somewhere inside, that Aunt Eva had treasured her family.
rows.enText: It was hard to believe. I didn’t want to admit it. Yet I did know, somewhere inside, that Aunt Eva had treasured her family.
rows.jaText:
……確かににわかには信じたくないし、認めたくはない。
でも、薄々はわかっている。確かに絵羽伯母さんは、家族をとても大切にしている人だった。

ja: 彼女の歪んだ人格の根底にあるのは、最愛の夫と息子を失った悲しみがあるだけなのだ。それを紛らわせるために八つ当たりされてきた私には、まったく同情する気持ちはないが、……それでも、彼女の人格を変容させるほどのショックを、家族全滅が与えたことは想像できなくもない。
en: Underneath her twisted personality lay the grief of losing the husband and son she loved. She’d taken it out on me to distract herself, and I felt no sympathy for her at all. But I could still imagine that losing her whole family had been a shock great enough to change her personality.
rows.enText: Underneath her twisted personality lay the grief of losing the husband and son she loved. She’d taken it out on me to distract herself, and I felt no sympathy for her at all. But I could still imagine that losing her whole family had been a shock great enough to change her personality.
rows.jaText: 彼女の歪んだ人格の根底にあるのは、最愛の夫と息子を失った悲しみがあるだけなのだ。それを紛らわせるために八つ当たりされてきた私には、まったく同情する気持ちはないが、……それでも、彼女の人格を変容させるほどのショックを、家族全滅が与えたことは想像できなくもない。

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「……家族を愛した絵羽伯母さんが、夫と息子を見捨てるわけがないと？」
en: “You mean, if she loved her family, she wouldn’t have abandoned her husband and son?”
rows.enText: “You mean, if she loved her family, she wouldn’t have abandoned her husband and son?”
rows.jaText: 「……家族を愛した絵羽伯母さんが、夫と息子を見捨てるわけがないと？」

ja: 「そうだ。もし本当に絵羽さんが犯人で、一族を事故に見せ掛けて皆殺しにしたならば。……夫と息子が、絶対に生き残ってるはずなんだ」
en: “Exactly. If she really was the culprit, if she’d killed the whole family and made it look like an accident... her husband and son would certainly have survived.”
rows.enText: “Exactly. If she really was the culprit, if she’d killed the whole family and made it look like an accident... her husband and son would certainly have survived.”
rows.jaText: 「そうだ。もし本当に絵羽さんが犯人で、一族を事故に見せ掛けて皆殺しにしたならば。……夫と息子が、絶対に生き残ってるはずなんだ」

ja: 「偶然、自分の家族だけが隠し館にいたと、屁理屈をこねてね。もし、秀吉さんと譲治くんも無事だったなら、さすがの俺でも、絵羽さんの陰謀を疑ったろうよ」「……俺は、秀吉さんの葬儀で見せた、絵羽さんのあの号泣を演技だなんて到底思えんねぇ」
en: “She’d have argued that her family just happened to be at the hidden mansion. If Hideyoshi and George had been safe too, even I would have suspected a conspiracy. And I simply can’t believe her sobbing at Hideyoshi’s funeral was an act.”
rows.enText: “She’d have argued that her family just happened to be at the hidden mansion. If Hideyoshi and George had been safe too, even I would have suspected a conspiracy. And I simply can’t believe her sobbing at Hideyoshi’s funeral was an act.”
rows.jaText: 「偶然、自分の家族だけが隠し館にいたと、屁理屈をこねてね。もし、秀吉さんと譲治くんも無事だったなら、さすがの俺でも、絵羽さんの陰謀を疑ったろうよ」「……俺は、秀吉さんの葬儀で見せた、絵羽さんのあの号泣を演技だなんて到底思えんねぇ」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「………どっちも状況証拠的ですね。絵羽伯母さんの潔白を、物理的に示すには至らない」
en: “Both your reasons are circumstantial. Neither offers concrete evidence of her innocence.”
rows.enText: “Both your reasons are circumstantial. Neither offers concrete evidence of her innocence.”
rows.jaText: 「………どっちも状況証拠的ですね。絵羽伯母さんの潔白を、物理的に示すには至らない」

ja: 「はっはっはっは。それを言っちゃおしまいだよ。生き残ったのは絵羽さんのみ。その彼女がそれが真実だ、と言うんだからさ」
en: “Hahahaha. Say that, and there’s nothing left to say. Eva was the only survivor. And she said that was the truth.”
rows.enText: “Hahahaha. Say that, and there’s nothing left to say. Eva was the only survivor. And she said that was the truth.”
rows.jaText: 「はっはっはっは。それを言っちゃおしまいだよ。生き残ったのは絵羽さんのみ。その彼女がそれが真実だ、と言うんだからさ」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「でも、彼女の潔白は誰にも証明できない」
en: “But no one can prove she was innocent.”
rows.enText: “But no one can prove she was innocent.”
rows.jaText: 「でも、彼女の潔白は誰にも証明できない」

ja: 「あぁ、そうさ。そして彼女の犯行も、誰にも証明できない」
en: “That’s right. And no one can prove she did it either.”
rows.enText: “That’s right. And no one can prove she did it either.”
rows.jaText: 「あぁ、そうさ。そして彼女の犯行も、誰にも証明できない」

ja: 「そして信ずるべきポイントの最後が、警察だ。何しろ、派手な事件だったからね。陰謀説を騒ぐ世論に後押しされて、警察がずいぶんと絵羽さんを調べたはずさ」
en: “And my last reason is the police. It was a spectacular affair, after all. With public opinion clamoring for a conspiracy, they must have investigated Eva very thoroughly.”
rows.enText: “And my last reason is the police. It was a spectacular affair, after all. With public opinion clamoring for a conspiracy, they must have investigated Eva very thoroughly.”

ja: 絵羽だけが隠し館に逃れていたために、偶然、事故を逃れた、とする点に不自然さを感じることも出来るだろう。また、当時、秀吉の会社は乗っ取り騒ぎの真っ最中にあり、大株主の買収のために、多額の現金を欲しがっていた。その点に動機を見出すことも、難しくはないはずだ。
en: It might seem unnatural to say that Eva had happened to escape the accident because she alone was at the hidden mansion. At the time, Hideyoshi’s company was also in the middle of a takeover crisis. He’d wanted a great deal of cash to buy out major shareholders. It wouldn’t be hard to find a motive there.

ja: しかし、親族会議に向かう絵羽の身辺は、まったくにもって普通だった。一族を事故に見せ掛けて虐殺するような、あらゆる不自然な準備が見つけられなかったのだ。当日は非番で難を逃れた使用人たちも、彼女を含め、全ての関係者について不自然な様子が見られなかったと証言した。
en: Yet everything about Eva’s circumstances as she left for the family conference had been perfectly ordinary. They’d found no suspicious preparations of any kind for slaughtering the family and disguising it as an accident. The servants who’d escaped because they were off duty that day had also testified that no one involved, including Eva, had behaved unusually.
rows.enText: Yet everything about Eva’s circumstances as she left for the family conference had been perfectly ordinary. They’d found no suspicious preparations of any kind for slaughtering the family and disguising it as an accident. The servants who’d escaped because they were off duty that day had also testified that no one involved, including Eva, had behaved unusually.

ja: それらを総合的に判断する限り、右代宮絵羽は普段の親族会議と何ら変わることなく、六軒島に向かい、事故に遭遇したと結論するしかないのだ…。
en: Considering all of that, the only possible conclusion was that Eva Ushiromiya had gone to Rokkenjima as she would for any other family conference, and encountered an accident...
rows.enText: Considering all of that, the only possible conclusion was that Eva Ushiromiya had gone to Rokkenjima as she would for any other family conference, and encountered an accident...

ja: 「警察が、あれだけ散々調べて、事件性を見出すことが出来なかった。……警察がそう断じた。それで六軒島疑惑は決着じゃないのかなぁ」
en: “The police investigated and investigated, and couldn’t find any sign of a crime. That was their conclusion. Doesn’t that settle the suspicions about Rokkenjima?”
rows.enText: “The police investigated and investigated, and couldn’t find any sign of a crime. That was their conclusion. Doesn’t that settle the suspicions about Rokkenjima?”

ja: 「それを言い出したらキリがないなぁ。悪魔の証明になっちまうよ。犯罪を暴くには証拠を見つければいい。でも、無実を示すには何を見つけりゃいいんだい？　消極的事実の証明は不可能だ」
en: “Start saying that, and there’s no end to it. You’ve got the problem of proving a negative. To expose a crime, you find evidence. But what do you find to show innocence? You can’t prove that something didn’t happen.”
rows.enText: “Start saying that, and there’s no end to it. You’ve got the problem of proving a negative. To expose a crime, you find evidence. But what do you find to show innocence? You can’t prove that something didn’t happen.”

ja: 「……絵羽伯母さんが、犯罪を犯したか、否か。それを判断する材料が見付からないから、そのまま真相は迷宮入り、ということですね」
en: “So they couldn’t find anything that would let them decide whether Aunt Eva had committed a crime. And the truth remained unsolved.”
rows.enText: “So they couldn’t find anything that would let them decide whether Aunt Eva had committed a crime. And the truth remained unsolved.”
rows.jaText: 「……絵羽伯母さんが、犯罪を犯したか、否か。それを判断する材料が見付からないから、そのまま真相は迷宮入り、ということですね」

ja: 「………そうだな。縁寿ちゃんの期待する言い方にするとそうなるな。絵羽さん自身にだって、自分の無実は証明不能なのさ」
en: “Yes. Put it the way you’d like, and that’s what it comes to. Even Eva couldn’t prove her own innocence.”
rows.enText: “Yes. Put it the way you’d like, and that’s what it comes to. Even Eva couldn’t prove her own innocence.”
rows.jaText: 「………そうだな。縁寿ちゃんの期待する言い方にするとそうなるな。絵羽さん自身にだって、自分の無実は証明不能なのさ」

ja: 「あの島で不幸な事故があった。そしてたまたま絵羽さんが生き残った。しかもそれ以上のことは何もわからない！」「つまるところ、唯一の生存者である、絵羽さんの話を、信じられるか否か、ってことになるわけさ」
en: “There was an unfortunate accident on that island. Eva happened to survive. And we don’t know anything beyond that! In the end, it comes down to whether you can believe the only survivor’s account.”
rows.enText: “There was an unfortunate accident on that island. Eva happened to survive. And we don’t know anything beyond that! In the end, it comes down to whether you can believe the only survivor’s account.”
rows.jaText: 「あの島で不幸な事故があった。そしてたまたま絵羽さんが生き残った。しかもそれ以上のことは何もわからない！」「つまるところ、唯一の生存者である、絵羽さんの話を、信じられるか否か、ってことになるわけさ」

ja: 「……俺は信じたよ。指輪の話や、彼女の尊敬できる家族愛。そして葬儀で見せた涙。それらを加味して考えて、彼女の話を信じようと思ったんだ」
en: “I believed her. The ring, her admirable love for her family, her tears at the funeral... I considered all of those things, and decided to believe her story.”
rows.enText: “I believed her. The ring, her admirable love for her family, her tears at the funeral... I considered all of those things, and decided to believe her story.”
rows.jaText: 「……俺は信じたよ。指輪の話や、彼女の尊敬できる家族愛。そして葬儀で見せた涙。それらを加味して考えて、彼女の話を信じようと思ったんだ」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「……でも、私は信じない。指輪なんて奪う気なら方法はいくらでもあるだろうし、家族仲が本当に良かったかなんて誰にもわからない。葬儀の涙が本物かなんて証明不能」
en: “But I don’t. If she wanted to steal the ring, there’d be any number of ways. No one knows if her family really got along. There’s no way to prove her tears at the funeral were real.”
rows.enText: “But I don’t. If she wanted to steal the ring, there’d be any number of ways. No one knows if her family really got along. There’s no way to prove her tears at the funeral were real.”
rows.jaText: 「……でも、私は信じない。指輪なんて奪う気なら方法はいくらでもあるだろうし、家族仲が本当に良かったかなんて誰にもわからない。葬儀の涙が本物かなんて証明不能」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
ja: 「……というか、私はそもそも絵羽伯母さんなんて大嫌い。だから私は彼女の話を信じようなんて思わない」
en: “Besides, I hate Aunt Eva to begin with. So I have no intention of believing her story.”
rows.enText: “Besides, I hate Aunt Eva to begin with. So I have no intention of believing her story.”
rows.jaText: 「……というか、私はそもそも絵羽伯母さんなんて大嫌い。だから私は彼女の話を信じようなんて思わない」

ja: 「はっはっはっは…。事件の真相をどう見るか。俺と縁寿ちゃんで真っ向から対立しちまったなぁ。俺たちに与えられてる情報はまったく同じなのに、まったく異なる見解を持っちまう」
en: “Hahahaha... So we’ve ended up with completely opposite views of what happened. We have exactly the same information, yet we see it in completely different ways.”
rows.enText: “Hahahaha... So we’ve ended up with completely opposite views of what happened. We have exactly the same information, yet we see it in completely different ways.”
rows.jaText: 「はっはっはっは…。事件の真相をどう見るか。俺と縁寿ちゃんで真っ向から対立しちまったなぁ。俺たちに与えられてる情報はまったく同じなのに、まったく異なる見解を持っちまう」

ja: 「………こういうこと、政治や経済でもよくあるんだ。同じ事業をやっても、必ず評価は分かれちまう。どうしてかわかるかい？」
en: “It happens often in politics and business too. Do the same thing, and people are bound to judge it differently. Do you know why?”
rows.enText: “It happens often in politics and business too. Do the same thing, and people are bound to judge it differently. Do you know why?”
rows.jaText: 「………こういうこと、政治や経済でもよくあるんだ。同じ事業をやっても、必ず評価は分かれちまう。どうしてかわかるかい？」

rows.speaker: Ange Ushiromiya
en: “No?”
rows.enText: “No?”

ja: 「愛があるかどうか、さ。……相手に愛を感じてるかどうかで、ものの見え方はまったく違うってことなんだ」
en: “Whether there’s love. Things look completely different depending on whether you feel love for the other person.”
rows.enText: “Whether there’s love. Things look completely different depending on whether you feel love for the other person.”
rows.jaText: 「愛があるかどうか、さ。……相手に愛を感じてるかどうかで、ものの見え方はまったく違うってことなんだ」

ja: 「好きな人が貧しい人に施しをすれば、尊敬できるだろ？　でも嫌いなヤツが施しなんて始めたら、売名行為だとかバラ撒き行政だとか、非難轟々さ」
en: “Someone you like gives to the poor, and you admire them, don’t you? But someone you hate does it, and everyone starts crying publicity stunt, handouts, and worse.”
rows.enText: “Someone you like gives to the poor, and you admire them, don’t you? But someone you hate does it, and everyone starts crying publicity stunt, handouts, and worse.”

ja: 「何をしてもしなくても、愛があれば感謝し、愛がなければ非難する。それが世の中ってもんなんだ」
en: “Whatever they do or don’t do, with love, you’re grateful. Without love, you condemn them. That’s the way of the world.”
rows.enText: “Whatever they do or don’t do, with love, you’re grateful. Without love, you condemn them. That’s the way of the world.”
rows.jaText: 「何をしてもしなくても、愛があれば感謝し、愛がなければ非難する。それが世の中ってもんなんだ」

ja: 「絵羽伯母さんのことを、信じられるか信じられないか、……それだけの違いってことですか？」
en: “So the only difference is whether I can believe Aunt Eva?”
rows.enText: “So the only difference is whether I can believe Aunt Eva?”
rows.jaText: 「絵羽伯母さんのことを、信じられるか信じられないか、……それだけの違いってことですか？」

ja: 「彼女を疑う人間には、彼女が何をしてもしなくても、それは実に不自然に見えるだろうさ。逆も然り。……俺はね。世の中には真実なんてものは、よっぽどのことがない限り、存在しないんじゃないかと思うね」
en: “To someone who suspects her, everything she does or doesn’t do must look terribly unnatural. And vice versa. I’m beginning to think that truth hardly ever exists in this world.”
rows.enText: “To someone who suspects her, everything she does or doesn’t do must look terribly unnatural. And vice versa. I’m beginning to think that truth hardly ever exists in this world.”

ja: 「いや、仮にもし。真実が存在したとしても、それを信じるか信じないかは、愛があるか否かで決められちまう」「……絶対性の宿らない真実なんて、真実と呼べるのかい？　絵羽さんが物理的なアリバイを示したとしても、君はそれを信じられたかい？」
en: “No, even supposing it does exist, whether you believe it is decided by whether there’s love. Can something that isn’t absolute be called the truth? If Eva had shown you a concrete alibi, could you have believed it?”
rows.enText: “No, even supposing it does exist, whether you believe it is decided by whether there’s love. Can something that isn’t absolute be called the truth? If Eva had shown you a concrete alibi, could you have believed it?”

ja: それを言われると弱い。…私は絵羽伯母さんが大嫌いだから、彼女に利するあらゆる情報は否定するし、中立的なあらゆる情報は悪意を以って解釈するだろう。……つまり、私の中で、もう真実は決め付けられているのだ。にもかかわらず、なおも満たされずに探す“真実”とは一体、何物なのか…。
en: He had me there. I hated Aunt Eva, so I’d reject any information that helped her, and put a malicious interpretation on anything neutral. In other words, I’d already decided what the truth was. Yet I still wasn’t satisfied. What was this “truth” I kept searching for?

en: “That’s what I mean. Whatever you hear from me, as long as you still suspect Eva, nothing you hear now will change anything. As you are now, I don’t think even discovering some new fact could lead you to the truth.”
rows.enText: “That’s what I mean. Whatever you hear from me, as long as you still suspect Eva, nothing you hear now will change anything. As you are now, I don’t think even discovering some new fact could lead you to the truth.”
